set.body: Implement retained global-key reparenting with scoped NodeRef/outlet identity, rollback/duplicate/cycle/disposal laws; synchronous filtered collection revisions/batches and revision-tagged range windows; fixed-height viewport+overscan realization without full-list processing on scroll, keyed selection/lifetime controls. Add independent models, JVM/Native review/receipts, public workbench specimen and concrete interactive-host/ScalaFX acceptance contract against current text/graphics APIs. Preserve concurrent graphics/text work; no claim of rendered or interactive implementation.
set.title: C1.5b/C1.6b retained outlets, virtual collections and host contract
